caption: The video captures hands working a pale lump of dough on a square wooden board dusted with flour, set on a white tabletop. One hand supports the left side of the dough while the other presses its upper surface, folding the mass over itself into an elongated log with a layered seam. The hands continue to press, smooth and gently shift the dough, working the fold into a longer, smoother log. The surrounding flour shifts outward, leaving bare wood visible around the dough. In the upper-right background sit a stainless-steel mixing bowl, a white container printed with 'Biscuits', and a small jar of multicolored sprinkles. The framing drifts subtly as the board's edges and background objects shift.
